scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,engine -c teal,yellow "npm --prefix apps/web run dev" "cd apps/engine && .venv/bin/python -m geoploitica_engine"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/atlas run build
scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/atlas install && cd apps/engine && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]"
